parameters.query:
SELECT
  input1.document_id AS id,
  COALESCE(input1.updated_date, input1.created_date) AS updatedDate,
  input1.name,
  input1.url,
  input1.created_username.username AS uploader
FROM input1
LEFT JOIN input2 ON input1.document_id = input2.documentId
WHERE (input2.documentId IS NULL
   OR input2.lastProcessedDate IS NULL
   OR input2.lastProcessedDate = ''
   OR COALESCE(input1.updated_date, input1.created_date) > input2.lastProcessedDate)
  AND input1.document_id IS NOT NULL
  AND input1.document_id != ''

assignments.name: cycle_id
assignments.value: ={{ String(($json.payload && $json.payload.document_id) || $('Merge Docs to Process').item.json.id) + ':' + String(($json.payload && $json.payload.updated_date) || $('Merge Docs to Process').item.json.updatedDate || $now.toISO()) }}

assignments.name: docUrl
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const u = String(($json.payload && $json.payload.url) || $('Merge Docs to Process').item.json.url || ''); return u.startsWith('http') ? u : ('https://exo.example.com' + u); })() }}

assignments.name: decision
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const raw = String($json.decision ?? $json.body?.decision ?? $json.query?.decision ?? '').trim(); const u = raw.toUpperCase(); if (u === 'APPROVED' || u === 'REJECTED') return u; if (raw.toLowerCase() === 'approved') return 'APPROVED'; if (raw.toLowerCase() === 'rejected') return 'REJECTED'; return ''; })() }}
